scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:production: pnpm run typecheck:production && pnpm --filter @workspace/propfirmmarket run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck:production: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/propfirmmarket run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck
